title: paginate audit log export
author: priya
body:
## Summary
This PR introduces paginated CSV export for the audit log, ensuring that large exports no longer time out.

## Key changes
- Added `exportAudit` with page-by-page streaming for better readability and maintainability.
- Updated `listAudit` to accept `page` and `size` arguments.
- Added tests to cover edge cases such as empty pages.

## Testing
- All existing and new tests pass locally.
commits:
feat(audit): paginate listAudit

Add page and size arguments with validation.

feat(audit): add paginated CSV export

Stream the audit log page by page to avoid timeouts.

test(audit): cover export edge cases

Add tests for empty logs and invalid sizes.
